stock.description: Yadong Group Holdings Limited specializes in the textile sector, focusing on the development, manufacturing, and supply of various fabric products. The company primarily serves garment producers and commercial trading enterprises. Its offerings include both plain weave and corduroy fabrics. Yadong Group's distribution footprint covers key markets such as China, Japan, Taiwan, Vietnam, Bangladesh, and Indonesia. Founded in 2011, the firm's main office is located in Sheung Wan, Hong Kong, and it functions as a subsidiary of Oriental Ever Holdings Limited.
